item.title: Ameen Sayani Birth Anniversary: Radio's voice Ameen Sayani dies of heart attack
item.description: The country's veteran radio host Ameen Sayani has passed away at the age of 91. Ameen Sayani died in Mumbai on Tuesday, 20 February 2024 due to a heart attack. His son Rajil Sayani confirmed the news of his father's death. There is a wave of mourning in the entire country due to the demise of Ameen Sayani.
